Campus Dining Guide

Meal plans

Every student living in a residence hall must hold a meal plan for the whole semester. The standard plan includes 19 meals per week served in the Fixture Dining Hall. Students who live off campus may buy a 10-meal weekly plan instead.

Unused meals do not roll over from one week to the next.

Opening hours

The Fixture Dining Hall follows the schedule below during the semester.

DayBreakfastLunchDinner
Monday to Friday07:00 to 09:3012:00 to 14:0018:30 to 20:30
Saturday and SundayWeekend brunch 10:30 to 13:00Included in brunch18:00 to 20:00

Dietary needs

Students with a food allergy can ask the dining manager for a personal meal card. Vegetarian and gluten-free dishes are labelled on the daily menu board at the entrance.

Guests

A student may bring up to two guests per week using meals from their own plan.
